figures.title: (a) The crystal structure of 1T and 1T′ phase of TMD MX2. (b) The relative total energy of 1T′ NM and FM CDW phases in VX2, CrX2, and MnX2 TMDs.
The relative total energy landscape of (a) CrS2, (b) CrSe2, and (c) CrTe2 under biaxial strain conditions.

(a) and (b) show the DOS results of 1T′ FM- and NM-CDW states of CrS2 and their partial charge density within the energy range of −1.5 to 0 eV. (c) The schematic diagram summarises the formation mechanisms of 1T′ FM-CDW and NM-CDW phases in CrS2.
The DOS and partial charge density results within electronic energy level range from −1.5 to 0 eV for (a) 1T′ MnS2, (b) MnSe2, and (c) MnTe2.
An overview of the 1T′ FM-CDW and NM-CDW phases in group IV, V, VI, and VII TMDs and the formation mechanisms of 1T′ FM-CDW phases.

Charge doping induced reversible phase transition between 1T′ NM and FM CDW phases in CrS2. (a) and (b) show the variation of lattice constants a and b under different electron and hole doping levels. (c) The phase transition energy barrier between the 1T′ NM and FM state under different charge doping.
